from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,itertools,json,resource,sys,time
import sympy as s
from sympy.polys.matrices import DomainMatrix
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(55,56));resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(1536*1024**2,)*2)
root=Path('/workspace/poisson-p4');sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'legacy/v03/code'))
import poisson_p4_components_check as p
start=time.monotonic();h,u,v,z,w,t=s.symbols('h u v z w t');xx=(h,u,v,z,w)
P=s.zeros(5)
for(i,j),f in zip(itertools.combinations(range(1,5),2),[-h*v,3*h*z-2*u*w,2*h*w+2*u*u,2*h*w+2*u*u+2*w*v,-2*u*v,4*w*w+6*u*z]):P[i,j]=f;P[j,i]=-f
R=s.zeros(5)
for(i,j),f in {(0,1):-2*h*u+2*u*v,(0,2):-4*h*v+6*v*v,(0,3):4*h*z-2*v*z,(0,4):2*u*u,(1,2):-u*v,(1,3):3*u*z,(2,3):11*v*z}.items():R[i,j]=f;R[j,i]=-f
pairs=list(itertools.combinations(range(5),2));triples=list(itertools.combinations(range(5),3));quads=list(itertools.combinations(range(5),4))
def sparse(A):return{(i,j):{e:int(c)for e,c in s.Poly(A[i,j],*xx).terms()if c}for i,j in pairs if A[i,j]!=0}
def vec(A):return s.Matrix([s.Poly(A[i,j],*xx).coeff_monomial(s.prod(x**a for x,a in zip(xx,e)))for(i,j),e in p.BIVECTOR_BASIS])
def jac(A):
 j={ijk:s.expand(sum(A[i,l]*s.diff(A[j,k],xx[l])+A[j,l]*s.diff(A[k,i],xx[l])+A[k,l]*s.diff(A[i,j],xx[l])for l in range(5)))for ijk in triples for i,j,k in[ijk]}
 q={inds:s.Poly(s.expand(sum((-1)**a*xx[inds[a]]*j[inds[:a]+inds[a+1:]]for a in range(4))),*xx)for inds in quads}
 return s.Matrix([q[inds].coeff_monomial(s.prod(x**a for x,a in zip(xx,e)))for inds,e in p.FOUR_VECTOR_BASIS])
D=s.Matrix(p.linearized_jacobi_matrix(sparse(P)));assert D*vec(R)==s.zeros(350,1)
dm=DomainMatrix.from_Matrix(D).convert_to(s.QQ);cols=list(dm.rref()[1]);assert len(cols)==102
rows=list(dm.extract(range(350),cols).transpose().rref()[1]);M=D.extract(rows,cols)
quadratic=jac(R)
sol=M.inv()*(-quadratic.extract(rows,[0]));Tvec=s.zeros(150,1)
for i,a in zip(cols,sol):Tvec[i]=a
residual=D*Tvec+quadratic
report={'task_id':'E_quadric3','full_D_rank_QQ':102,'full_tangent_dimension':48,'actual_orbit_vertical_scale_rank_dependency':47,'normal_R':{str(ij):str(R[ij])for ij in pairs if R[ij]!=0},'D_R_exact_zero':True,'quadratic_residual_zero':residual==s.zeros(350,1)}
if residual!=s.zeros(350,1):
 i=next(i for i,a in enumerate(residual)if a)
 co=M.T.inv()*D.extract([i],cols).T
 left=s.zeros(1,350);left[0,i]=1
 for j,a in zip(rows,co):left[0,j]-=a
 den=s.ilcm(*[s.denom(a)for a in left]);left=left*den
 nums=[abs(int(a))for a in left if a];g=s.igcd(*nums);left=left/g
 assert left*D==s.zeros(1,150) and (left*quadratic)[0]!=0
 report.update(nonzero_quadratic_obstruction=True,left_cokernel_witness={str(j):str(a)for j,a in enumerate(left)if a},left_times_quadratic=str((left*quadratic)[0]),classification_implication='True one-normal formal slice has nonzero quadratic initial equation, hence dimension0; actual22-dimensional projective orbit closure is a full component, subject to independent review and distinctness audit.')
else:
 T=s.zeros(5)
 for a,((i,j),e)in zip(Tvec,p.BIVECTOR_BASIS):T[i,j]+=a*s.prod(x**n for x,n in zip(xx,e));T[j,i]=-T[i,j]
 assert jac(P+t*R+t*t*T).applyfunc(lambda f:s.Poly(f,t).coeff_monomial(t**2))==s.zeros(350,1)
 cubic=jac(R+T)-jac(R)-jac(T)
 coeff=M.inv()*cubic.extract(rows,[0]);rest=cubic-D.extract(range(350),cols)*coeff
 report.update(second_correction={str(ij):str(s.expand(T[ij]))for ij in pairs if T[ij]!=0},cubic_residual_zero=rest==s.zeros(350,1),classification_implication='No quadratic obstruction; cubic remainder requires ambiguity check before support conclusion.')
report.update(input_sha256={'code/classification_double_quadric.py':hashlib.sha256((root/'code/classification_double_quadric.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'reports/CLASSIFICATION_RANK3_TANGENT_EXTRA_SOURCES_20261107.json':hashlib.sha256((root/'reports/CLASSIFICATION_RANK3_TANGENT_EXTRA_SOURCES_20261107.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()},source=Path(__file__).read_text(),source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
(root/'work/rank3-mixed-support-obstruction.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items()if k not in('source','left_cokernel_witness','input_sha256','normal_R','second_correction')},indent=2))
